out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE PARASITE DESTRUCTION FOR ONE OF THEIR VENDORS FOR FISH THAT MAY BE ORDERED UNDERCOOKED.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC UNDERSTANDS LETTERS OF PARASITE DESTRUCTION MUST BE OBTAINED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EACH SPECIES OF FISH RECEIVED FROM THIS VENDOR IS LISTED ON THE LETTER. Brx American Bistro (Inspection Date: 08/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 43-48F IN THE TWO-DRAWER PREP-TOP; OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 47F AND OLD BAY BUTTER AT 48F IN THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER; OBSERVED HEAVY CREAM AT 49F AND HALF AND HALF AT 46F IN THE 1-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO DISCLOSURE STATEMENT ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE UPDATE MENU AND PROVIDE MENU TO EHS BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO THERMOMETER IN THE FOLLOWING REFRIGERATION UNITS: TWO-DRAWER PREP-TOP, TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP, AND 1- DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS A SENSOR SYSTEM FOR EVERY COOLER, HOWEVER, THE SYSTEM WAS DOWN AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PLEASE ADD UNIT THERMOMETERS TO ALL COOLER AS A BACKUP TEMPERATURE TRACKING METHOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE BOTTOM DRAWER OF THE TWO-DRAWER PREP-TOP AT 54F WITH EHS THERMOMETER, THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER AT 50-55F, AND THE 1-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 42F WITH THE EHS THERMOMETER. OBSERVED THE BAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AT 0PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PICS DISCARDED/MOVED FOODS IN THESE COOLERS. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COOLERS ARE MAINTAINED BETWEEN 34-38F TO ENSURE COLD HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF OF REPAIR BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. BAR DISHWASHING MACHINE SHALL NOT BE USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZED BETWEN 50-200PPM.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Approved Record Keeping, Tags/Labels
violations.observation: Observed shellstock tags for oysters and mussels mixed together in a plastic container.
violations.corrective_action: Tags/labels must be maintained in chronological order by the date recorded on the tag/label when the last shellstock is used/sold. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SEPARATE MUSSEL AND OYSTER TAGS AND TO ORGANIZE THEM IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER. PIC ORGANIZED THE TAG APPROPRIATELY.

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The farm-raised salmon served raw or partially cooked was observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3).
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. PROVIDE EHS WITH A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR THE SALMON BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR prep top Fry cooler, cooked chicken (42f), baked potatoes (44f), cooked chicken wings (47f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. Brx American Bistro (Inspection Date: 01/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) beef stock; 2) meatballs; 3) lobster stock
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) bar dish washer was observed under the required chlorine concentration; 2) Sink and surface lactic acid sanitizer dispenser was observed malfunctioning. Dispenser was not dispensing sanitizer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE USING THE BAR DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. ALL GLASSWARE MUST BE TAKEN TO MAIN DISH MACHINE IN THE MEANTIME. DISCONTINUE USING THE SANITIZER DISPENSER UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. PIC IS USING BLEACH AS BACK UP SANITIZER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed no backflow prevention device on the water lines attached to the coffee and espresso machine.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICES INSTALLED. PIC STATES HE WILL INFORM THE TECHNICIAN TO INSTALL THE DEVICES WHEN HE RETURNS TO FIX THE WATER LINES.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Designed to Prevent Condensate Drip
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of grease dripping down on the interior of the hood along the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Exhaust ventilation hood systems in food preparation and warewashing areas including components such as hoods, fans, guards, and ducting shall be designed to prevent grease or condensation from draining or dripping onto food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Meat slicer was observed with food debris. Upon discussion with chef, meat slicer was not used today and was likely used a couple of days prior.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC STARTED CLEANING THE MEAT SLICER DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Personal care items such as, over the counter pain medication and burn spray, were observed being stored on a shelf next to food preparation equipment in the dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS TO THE OFFICE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The exhaust hoods above the cook line and the exhaust hoods above the ovens were observed with excess grease and oil deposits.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: EHS observed Ibuprofen and commercial burn spray being stored above food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC removed items from above food contact surfaces and stored them with other personal care items away from food contact surfaces.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS Observed Sable in the Walk in Cooler thawed in Reduced oxygen packaging without a hole being cut in the packaging or being removed from packaging.
violations.corrective_action: PIC disposed of the Sable that was thawed in the Reduced Oxygen Packaging. EHS reviewed Reduced Oxygen Packaging with the PIC
